serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Oh! Just in time.
Big Daddy: Listen Anon. I was thinking about our last talk.
Big Daddy: I noticed that there was a lot of doubt in you when you were leaving to deliver da package…
He’s acting unusually serious… What’s going on?
Big Daddy: It might have appeared to you that I’m not fazed by da gun and possible consequences of our actions, but that couldn’t be further from da truth.
Big Daddy: Right now I live in a lot of stress. My work, my wife, my kids…
Big Daddy: Nonetheless I decided to stop these dangerous people and help you, who got mixed up in all of this by accident. Risking my own skin doing so.
Big Daddy: You might think that delivering that gun was an inhumane thing to do, but I want you to believe me that at da time I thought that was da best course of action.
Big Daddy: I’m asking you for your forgiveness and I hope that you will put your trust in me once again.
I can’t believe that Big Daddy apologized and even bowed down a little…
Now I feel kinda bad for ever doubting him. He has his own troubles, but regardless got involved in this for everyone’s sake…
You: N-no, Big Daddy! Please raise your head. I’m sorry for making you feel that way. I know it wasn’t an easy decision for you and I put even more on your shoulders by acting like a kid…
Big Daddy: No, no. You don’t have to apologize, I was completely out of line that time.
Big Daddy: Although I feel ashamed, I need to ask you to help me end that organization once and for all.
You: Of course. I will help you in whatever way I can.
Big Daddy: Good, I’m glad to hear that.
Big Daddy: In his last blog post Admin published he mentioned a problem with da power consumption. We can use that to our advantage.
Big Daddy: I’m sure he hid well his activity by using shell companies and stealing electricity from da main grid or something similar, so we are not gonna even try to investigate that.
Big Daddy: What we will do instead is to go to da offensive. 
Big Daddy: Whatever solution he’s using is not enough to power up his equipment. That’s where you come in. We will send him an email offering help with his problem. If we are lucky, he will take da bait and we will be able to apprehend him.
You: It’s a good plan Big Daddy, don’t get me wrong, but will he trust us enough to reveal himself?
Big Daddy: You already finished a few missions as far as he knows and I will do da talk. I know exactly what he will want to hear since I was in his shoes a long time ago while I was a part of Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism.
You: And what if it doesn’t work?
Big Daddy: If he decides to break contact with us, your mission will be over. If not, we will try something else later.
Big Daddy: I will use your email address for a while and clone the phone they contact you on, if you don’t mind. I will try to set up a meeting. All you will have to do is take a picture of Admin and send it to me. Then, I will contact da authorities and that’s it.
You: Sounds good to me, although I’m kinda afraid of talking with him in person. 
Big Daddy: Don’t be. I will try to set it up in some public place to ensure your safety the best I can. They won’t be trying anything funny with a lot of people in there.
You: Alright. I will be waiting.
Big Daddy: Thank you and good luck, little one!
